cell.catalog_convention: Fixed balanced cycles of original full sample std widths and paired E0 point predictions; no data selection by width
cell.not_claimed: Original target guarantees no power after nuisance addition; covariance/selection/waveform calibration remain OPEN

components.mean_handling: r = y - X*m; covariance V is fixed local E1 INPUT, not calibrated physical uncertainty
components.target_source: ceil(E0 N90 fixed-effect mixture); not 90% power guaranteed after adding nuisance

result.scope: Synthetic posterior and fixed estimated covariance only; not waveform/selection/null calibration of the real experiment

analytic_tail_control.method: chi2_5 integral of conditional normal tail; measurement shared t5 scale plus Gaussian nuisance

familywise: Per-cell intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted discovery from these controls
